entries.0aabe75ed86f5b3c: A holding company under SBI Holdings that brings together a group of investment trust management companies and financial information services.
entries.1813eccb58726f2d: A business that, under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, performs investment management, including the establishment, offering and management of investment trusts centered on publicly offered add-on type equity investment trusts and privately placed bond-type investment trusts, as well as investment advisory services, investment counseling and discretionary services. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥26,332 million, the largest of the 2 businesses. The core consists of 3 companies, SBI Asset Management Co., Ltd., SBI Okasan Asset Management Co., Ltd. and Rheos Capital Works Inc., and Carret Asset Management LLC of the United States is also under its umbrella.

entries.51adbddbc0c746fc: A business that collects information such as financial and website information, and compares, analyzes, evaluates and processes the accumulated information to provide it to customers. It provides the WEB edition of "Kabushiki Shimbun", custom fund data to financial institutions, media and others, selection and announcement of fund awards, investment trust comparison and analysis tools, evaluation information on crypto assets, corporate IR support and seminars. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,526 million, and consolidated subsidiary Wealth Advisor Co., Ltd. handles the business.
